title: त्रयोदशोऽध्यायः
titleEn: Adhyaya 13 · Krishna visits the exiles; Draupadi's lament

summary.en: Krishna, with the Vrishnis, Dhrishtadyumna and the Kekaya princes, visits the Pandavas and in fury vows to destroy their enemies; Arjuna calms him by praising his ancient deeds as Narayana. Draupadi pours out to Krishna the story of her humiliation, and Krishna promises that she will be queen again and her tormentors will lie dead.
summary.kn: ವೃಷ್ಣಿಗಳು, ಧೃಷ್ಟದ್ಯುಮ್ನ, ಕೇಕಯ ರಾಜಕುಮಾರರೊಂದಿಗೆ ಶ್ರೀಕೃಷ್ಣನು ಪಾಂಡವರನ್ನು ಭೇಟಿಯಾಗಿ ಕೋಪದಿಂದ ಶತ್ರುನಾಶದ ಪ್ರತಿಜ್ಞೆ ಮಾಡುತ್ತಾನೆ; ನಾರಾಯಣನಾಗಿ ಅವನ ಪ್ರಾಚೀನ ಕಾರ್ಯಗಳನ್ನು ಹೊಗಳಿ ಅರ್ಜುನನು ಶಾಂತಗೊಳಿಸುತ್ತಾನೆ. ದ್ರೌಪದಿ ತನ್ನ ಅವಮಾನದ ಕಥೆಯನ್ನು ತೋಡಿಕೊಳ್ಳುತ್ತಾಳೆ; ಅವಳು ಮತ್ತೆ ರಾಣಿಯಾಗುವಳು, ಪೀಡಕರು ಸತ್ತುಬೀಳುವರು ಎಂದು ಶ್ರೀಕೃಷ್ಣನು ವಾಗ್ದಾನ ಮಾಡುತ್ತಾನೆ.
summary.hi: वृष्णियों, धृष्टद्युम्न और केकय राजकुमारों के साथ श्रीकृष्ण पाण्डवों से मिलते हैं और क्रोध में शत्रुओं के विनाश की प्रतिज्ञा करते हैं; अर्जुन नारायण रूप में उनके प्राचीन कार्यों की स्तुति कर उन्हें शान्त करते हैं। द्रौपदी श्रीकृष्ण के सामने अपने अपमान की कथा उँडेल देती हैं, और श्रीकृष्ण वचन देते हैं कि वे फिर रानी बनेंगी और उनके पीड़क मारे जाएँगे।
summary.te: వృష్ణులు, ధృష్టద్యుమ్నుడు, కేకయ రాజకుమారులతో శ్రీకృష్ణుడు పాండవులను సందర్శించి కోపంతో శత్రునాశనానికి ప్రతిజ్ఞ చేస్తాడు; నారాయణునిగా ఆయన పూర్వకార్యాలను కీర్తించి అర్జునుడు శాంతపరుస్తాడు. ద్రౌపది తన అవమాన కథను శ్రీకృష్ణునికి వెళ్లబోసుకుంటుంది; ఆమె మళ్లీ రాణి అవుతుందని, ఆమెను పీడించినవారు చచ్చిపడతారని శ్రీకృష్ణుడు వాగ్దానం చేస్తాడు.
summary.ta: வ்ருஷ்ணிகள், த்ருஷ்டத்யும்னன், கேகய இளவரசர்களுடன் ஸ்ரீகிருஷ்ணர் பாண்டவர்களைச் சந்தித்துச் சினத்துடன் பகைவர்களை அழிப்பதாகச் சபதம் செய்கிறார்; நாராயணராக அவர் செய்த பழம் செயல்களைப் புகழ்ந்து அர்ஜுனன் அவரை அமைதிப்படுத்துகிறான். திரௌபதி தன் அவமானக் கதையை ஸ்ரீகிருஷ்ணரிடம் கொட்ட, அவள் மீண்டும் அரசியாவாள், அவளைத் துன்புறுத்தியோர் மடிவர் என்று ஸ்ரீகிருஷ்ணர் வாக்களிக்கிறார்.
summary.ml: കൃഷ്ണൻ വൃഷ്ണികളോടും ധൃഷ്ടദ്യുമ്നനോടും കേകയ രാജകുമാരന്മാരോടുമൊപ്പം പാണ്ഡവരെ സന്ദർശിച്ച് കോപത്തോടെ ശത്രുക്കളെ നശിപ്പിക്കുമെന്ന് പ്രതിജ്ഞ ചെയ്യുന്നു; നാരായണനെന്ന നിലയിലെ പൂർവകാല പരാക്രമങ്ങളെ പ്രശംസിച്ച് അർജുനൻ അദ്ദേഹത്തെ ശാന്തനാക്കുന്നു. തനിക്കേറ്റ അപമാനം ദ്രൗപദി കൃഷ്ണനോട് തുറന്നുപറയുന്നു; അവൾ വീണ്ടും രാജ്ഞിയാകുമെന്നും അവളെ പീഡിപ്പിച്ചവർ മരിച്ചുവീഴുമെന്നും കൃഷ്ണൻ വാക്കുനൽകുന്നു.

source: Mahabharata, Critical Edition (BORI, Pune) 3.13; e-text by M. Tokunaga and J. D. Smith, © BORI 1999, version of Mon Apr 11 2022

verses.text: वैशंपायन उवाच

meaning.en: Vaishampayana said:

verses.text:
भोजाः प्रव्रजिताञ्श्रुत्वा वृष्णयश्चान्धकैः सह ।
पाण्डवान्दुःखसंतप्तान्समाजग्मुर्महावने ॥

meaning.en: Hearing that the Pandavas had gone into exile, the Bhojas, the Vrishnis and the Andhakas came together to the great forest, where the sons of Pandu were burning with grief.

verses.text:
पाञ्चालस्य च दायादा धृष्टकेतुश्च चेदिपः ।
केकयाश्च महावीर्या भ्रातरो लोकविश्रुताः ॥

meaning.en: The Panchala king's heirs, Dhrishtaketu the king of the Chedis, and the mighty Kekaya brothers, famed in the world, also came.

verses.text:
वने तेऽभिययुः पार्थान्क्रोधामर्शसमन्विताः ।
गर्हयन्तो धार्तराष्ट्रान्किं कुर्म इति चाब्रुवन् ॥

meaning.en: They came to the sons of Pritha in the forest filled with anger and indignation, condemning Dhritarashtra's sons and asking, "What shall we do?"

verses.text:
वासुदेवं पुरस्कृत्य सर्वे ते क्षत्रियर्षभाः ।
परिवार्योपविविशुर्धर्मराजं युधिष्ठिरम् ॥

meaning.en: Putting Vasudeva Krishna first, all those bulls among Kshatriyas sat around Dharmaraja Yudhishthira.

verses.text: वासुदेव उवाच

meaning.en: Vasudeva said:

verses.text:
दुर्योधनस्य कर्णस्य शकुनेश्च दुरात्मनः ।
दुःशासनचतुर्थानां भूमिः पास्यति शोणितम् ॥

meaning.en: The earth will drink the blood of Duryodhana, Karna, wicked Shakuni and Duhshasana as fourth.

verses.text:
ततः सर्वेऽभिषिञ्चामो धर्मराजं युधिष्ठिरम् ।
निकृत्योपचरन्वध्य एष धर्मः सनातनः ॥

meaning.en: Then let us all install Dharmaraja Yudhishthira on the throne; one who deals with a cheat by deceit should be killed. This is the eternal dharma.

verses.text: वैशंपायन उवाच

meaning.en: Vaishampayana said:

verses.text:
पार्थानामभिषङ्गेण तथा क्रुद्धं जनार्दनम् ।
अर्जुनः शमयामासा दिधक्षन्तमिव प्रजाः ॥

meaning.en: Janardana, angered at the wrong done to the Pandavas, seemed ready to burn up creatures, but Arjuna calmed him.

verses.text:
संक्रुद्धं केशवं दृष्ट्वा पूर्वदेहेषु फल्गुनः ।
कीर्तयामास कर्माणि सत्यकीर्तेर्महात्मनः ॥

meaning.en: Seeing Keshava enraged, Phalguna recounted the deeds of that great soul of true fame in his earlier embodiments.

verses.text:
पुरुषस्याप्रमेयस्य सत्यस्यामिततेजसः ।
प्रजापतिपतेर्विष्णोर्लोकनाथस्य धीमतः ॥

meaning.en: He sang of the immeasurable Person, the true one of boundless splendor, Vishnu, the wise lord of the worlds and master of the lords of creatures.

verses.text: अर्जुन उवाच

meaning.en: Arjuna said:

verses.text:
दश वर्षसहस्राणि यत्रसायंगृहो मुनिः ।
व्यचरस्त्वं पुरा कृष्ण पर्वते गन्धमादने ॥

meaning.en: Krishna, long ago you wandered as a sage on Mount Gandhamadana, with the evening as your home, for ten thousand years.

verses.text:
दश वर्षसहस्राणि दश वर्षशतानि च ।
पुष्करेष्ववसः कृष्ण त्वमपो भक्षयन्पुरा ॥

meaning.en: Krishna, you lived at Pushkara for eleven thousand years, long ago, living on water alone.

verses.text:
ऊर्ध्वबाहुर्विशालायां बदर्यां मधुसूदन ।
अतिष्ठ एकपादेन वायुभक्षः शतं समाः ॥

meaning.en: Madhusudana, at Badari in Vishala you stood with arms raised on one foot for a hundred years, living on air.

verses.text:
अपकृष्टोत्तरासङ्गः कृशो धमनिसंततः ।
आसीः कृष्ण सरस्वत्यां सत्रे द्वादशवार्षिके ॥

meaning.en: Krishna, with your upper garment cast off, thin, your veins showing, you sat at the twelve-year sacrifice on the Sarasvati.

verses.text:
प्रभासं चाप्यथासाद्य तीर्थं पुण्यजनोचितम् ।
तथा कृष्ण महातेजा दिव्यं वर्षसहस्रकम् ।
आतिष्ठस्तप एकेन पादेन नियमे स्थितः ॥

meaning.en: And Krishna, reaching Prabhasa, a holy place suited to holy people, you of great splendor practiced austerity for a thousand divine years on one foot, firm in your vow.

verses.text:
क्षेत्रज्ञः सर्वभूतानामादिरन्तश्च केशव ।
निधानं तपसां कृष्ण यज्ञस्त्वं च सनातनः ॥

meaning.en: Keshava, you are the knower of the field in all beings, their beginning and end, the treasury of austerities, and you are the eternal sacrifice.

verses.text:
निहत्य नरकं भौममाहृत्य मणिकुण्डले ।
प्रथमोत्पादितं कृष्ण मेध्यमश्वमवासृजः ॥

meaning.en: Krishna, after killing Naraka, son of Earth, and bringing back the jeweled earrings, you let loose the first-born consecrated horse.

verses.text:
कृत्वा तत्कर्म लोकानामृषभः सर्वलोकजित् ।
अवधीस्त्वं रणे सर्वान्समेतान्दैत्यदानवान् ॥

meaning.en: Having done that deed for the worlds, bull among beings, conqueror of all worlds, you killed in battle all the Daityas and Danavas gathered together.

verses.text:
ततः सर्वेश्वरत्वं च संप्रदाय शचीपतेः ।
मानुषेषु महाबाहो प्रादुर्भूतोऽसि केशव ॥

meaning.en: Then, having given Shachi's husband Indra his sovereignty over all, mighty-armed Keshava, you appeared among humans.

verses.text:
स त्वं नारायणो भूत्वा हरिरासीः परंतप ।
ब्रह्मा सोमश्च सूर्यश्च धर्मो धाता यमोऽनलः ॥

meaning.en: Scorcher of foes, you became Narayana and Hari. You are Brahma, Soma, Surya, Dharma, Dhatri, Yama and Agni.

verses.text:
वायुर्वैश्रवणो रुद्रः कालः खं पृथिवी दिशः ।
अजश्चराचरगुरुः स्रष्टा त्वं पुरुषोत्तम ॥

meaning.en: Vayu, Vaishravana, Rudra, Time, space, earth and the quarters; you are the unborn teacher of the moving and unmoving, the creator, best of persons.

verses.text:
तुरायणादिभिर्देव क्रतुभिर्भूरिदक्षिणैः ।
अयजो भूरितेजा वै कृष्ण चैत्ररथे वने ॥

meaning.en: God, with sacrifices such as the Turayana, with ample gifts, you of vast splendor sacrificed in the Chaitraratha forest.

verses.text:
शतं शतसहस्राणि सुवर्णस्य जनार्दन ।
एकैकस्मिंस्तदा यज्ञे परिपूर्णानि भागशः ॥

meaning.en: Janardana, in each of those sacrifices a hundred times a hundred thousand gold pieces were given out in full portions.

verses.text:
अदितेरपि पुत्रत्वमेत्य यादवनन्दन ।
त्वं विष्णुरिति विख्यात इन्द्रादवरजो भुवि ॥

meaning.en: Joy of the Yadavas, you took birth even as Aditi's son and became known on earth as Vishnu, Indra's younger brother.

verses.text:
शिशुर्भूत्वा दिवं खं च पृथिवीं च परंतप ।
त्रिभिर्विक्रमणैः कृष्ण क्रान्तवानसि तेजसा ॥

meaning.en: Becoming a child, scorcher of foes, Krishna, you strode with your power across heaven, sky and earth in three steps.

verses.text:
संप्राप्य दिवमाकाशमादित्यसदने स्थितः ।
अत्यरोचश्च भूतात्मन्भास्करं स्वेन तेजसा ॥

meaning.en: Reaching heaven and the sky, standing in the Sun's dwelling, soul of beings, you outshone the sun with your own radiance.

verses.text:
सादिता मौरवाः पाशा निसुन्दनरकौ हतौ ।
कृतः क्षेमः पुनः पन्थाः पुरं प्राग्ज्योतिषं प्रति ॥

meaning.en: You destroyed the snares of Mura, killed Nisunda and Naraka, and made safe again the road to the city of Pragjyotisha.

verses.text:
जारूथ्यामाहुतिः क्राथः शिशुपालो जनैः सह ।
भीमसेनश्च शैब्यश्च शतधन्वा च निर्जितः ॥

meaning.en: Janardana, you defeated Ahuti at Jarudhi, Kratha, Shishupala with his people, Bhimasena, Shaibya and Shatadhanva.

verses.text:
तथा पर्जन्यघोषेण रथेनादित्यवर्चसा ।
अवाक्षीर्महिषीं भोज्यां रणे निर्जित्य रुक्मिणम् ॥

meaning.en: And on your chariot sounding like thunder-clouds and shining like the sun, you carried off the Bhoja princess after defeating Rukmin in battle.

verses.text:
इन्द्रद्युम्नो हतः कोपाद्यवनश्च कशेरुमान् ।
हतः सौभपतिः शाल्वस्त्वया सौभं च पातितम् ॥

meaning.en: In anger you killed Indradyumna and Yavana Kasherumat; you killed Shalva, lord of Saubha, and brought down the Saubha city.

verses.text:
इरावत्यां तथा भोजः कार्तवीर्यसमो युधि ।
गोपतिस्तालकेतुश्च त्वया विनिहतावुभौ ॥

meaning.en: Likewise at Iravati you killed Bhoja, equal to Kartavirya in battle, and Gopati and Talaketu, both.

verses.text:
तां च भोगवतीं पुण्यामृषिकान्तां जनार्दन ।
द्वारकामात्मसात्कृत्वा समुद्रं गमयिष्यसि ॥

meaning.en: Janardana, you will make that holy Bhogavati, Dvaraka, loved by sages, your own, and send it into the sea.

verses.text:
न क्रोधो न च मात्सर्यं नानृतं मधुसूदन ।
त्वयि तिष्ठति दाशार्ह न नृशंस्यं कुतोऽनृजु ॥

meaning.en: Madhusudana, anger, envy and falsehood do not dwell in you, descendant of Dasharha, nor cruelty; how then crookedness?

verses.text:
आसीनं चित्तमध्ये त्वां दीप्यमानं स्वतेजसा ।
आगम्य ऋषयः सर्वेऽयाचन्ताभयमच्युत ॥

meaning.en: Acyuta, when you sat blazing with your own radiance in the midst of thought, all the sages came to you and begged for freedom from fear.

verses.text:
युगान्ते सर्वभूतानि संक्षिप्य मधुसूदन ।
आत्मन्येवात्मसात्कृत्वा जगदास्से परंतप ॥

meaning.en: Madhusudana, at the end of the age you gather all beings into yourself, scorcher of foes, and sit as the world, made one with yourself.

verses.text:
नैवं पूर्वे नापरे वा करिष्यन्ति कृतानि ते ।
कर्माणि यानि देव त्वं बाल एव महाद्युते ॥

meaning.en: God of great splendor, neither earlier nor later ones will do the deeds that you did as a mere boy.

verses.text:
कृतवान्पुण्डरीकाक्ष बलदेवसहायवान् ।
वैराजभवने चापि ब्रह्मणा न्यवसः सह ॥

meaning.en: Lotus-eyed one, you did them with Baladeva as your helper, and you also lived with Brahma in the palace of Viraj.

verses.text: वैशंपायन उवाच

meaning.en: Vaishampayana said:

verses.text:
एवमुक्त्वा तदात्मानमात्मा कृष्णस्य पाण्डवः ।
तूष्णीमासीत्ततः पार्थमित्युवाच जनार्दनः ॥

meaning.en: Having thus spoken of Krishna's own self, Arjuna, Krishna's very self, fell silent, and Janardana said this to Partha.

verses.text:
ममैव त्वं तवैवाहं ये मदीयास्तवैव ते ।
यस्त्वां द्वेष्टि स मां द्वेष्टि यस्त्वामनु स मामनु ॥

meaning.en: You are mine and I am yours; whoever is mine is yours. Whoever hates you hates me, and whoever follows you follows me.

verses.text:
नरस्त्वमसि दुर्धर्ष हरिर्नारायणो ह्यहम् ।
लोकाल्लोकमिमं प्राप्तौ नरनारायणावृषी ॥

meaning.en: You are Nara, invincible, and I am Hari Narayana. We are the two sages Nara and Narayana, come to this world from another world.

verses.text:
अनन्यः पार्थ मत्तस्त्वमहं त्वत्तश्च भारत ।
नावयोरन्तरं शक्यं वेदितुं भरतर्षभ ॥

meaning.en: Partha, you are not different from me nor I from you, descendant of Bharata. No difference between us can be known, bull of the Bharatas.

verses.text:
तस्मिन्वीरसमावाये संरब्धेष्वथ राजसु ।
धृष्टद्युम्नमुखैर्वीरैर्भ्रातृभिः परिवारिता ॥

meaning.en: In that gathering of heroes, while the kings were stirred, Panchali, surrounded by her brothers led by Dhrishtadyumna,

verses.text:
पाञ्चाली पुण्डरीकाक्षमासीनं यादवैः सह ।
अभिगम्याब्रवीत्कृष्णा शरण्यं शरणैषिणी ॥

meaning.en: approached lotus-eyed Krishna as he sat with the Yadavas, and she, Krishna Draupadi, seeking refuge, spoke to him, the refuge.

verses.text:
पूर्वे प्रजानिसर्गे त्वामाहुरेकं प्रजापतिम् ।
स्रष्टारं सर्वभूतानामसितो देवलोऽब्रवीत् ॥

meaning.en: In the earlier creation of beings, Asita Devala called you the one Lord of creatures, the creator of all beings.

verses.text:
विष्णुस्त्वमसि दुर्धर्ष त्वं यज्ञो मधुसूदन ।
यष्टा त्वमसि यष्टव्यो जामदग्न्यो यथाब्रवीत् ॥

meaning.en: You are Vishnu, invincible; you are the sacrifice, Madhusudana. You are the sacrificer and what is to be sacrificed, as Jamadagni's son said.

verses.text:
ऋषयस्त्वां क्षमामाहुः सत्यं च पुरुषोत्तम ।
सत्याद्यज्ञोऽसि संभूतः कश्यपस्त्वां यथाब्रवीत् ॥

meaning.en: Sages call you forbearance and truth, best of persons. You are the sacrifice born of truth, as Kashyapa said.

verses.text:
साध्यानामपि देवानां वसूनामीश्वरेश्वरः ।
लोकभावन लोकेश यथा त्वां नारदोऽब्रवीत् ॥

meaning.en: You are the lord of lords of the Sadhyas, the gods and the Vasus, maker of the worlds, lord of the worlds, as Narada said of you.

verses.text:
दिवं ते शिरसा व्याप्तं पद्भ्यां च पृथिवी विभो ।
जठरं ते इमे लोकाः पुरुषोऽसि सनातनः ॥

meaning.en: Your head fills the sky, lord, and your feet the earth; these worlds are your belly. You are the eternal Person.

verses.text:
विद्यातपोऽभितप्तानां तपसा भावितात्मनाम् ।
आत्मदर्शनसिद्धानामृषीणामृषिसत्तम ॥

meaning.en: You are the goal, best of persons, of sages scorched by learning and austerity, whose selves are refined by tapas, and perfected in vision of the Self,

verses.text:
राजर्षीणां पुण्यकृतामाहवेष्वनिवर्तिनाम् ।
सर्वधर्मोपपन्नानां त्वं गतिः पुरुषोत्तम ॥

meaning.en: of royal sages who did good deeds and never turned back in battle, endowed with all dharma.

verses.text:
त्वं प्रभुस्त्वं विभुस्त्वं भूरात्मभूस्त्वं सनातनः ।
लोकपालाश्च लोकाश्च नक्षत्राणि दिशो दश ।
नभश्चन्द्रश्च सूर्यश्च त्वयि सर्वं प्रतिष्ठितम् ॥

meaning.en: You are the lord, the all-pervading, the earth, the self-existent, the eternal. The guardians of the worlds, the worlds, the stars, the ten directions, the sky, the moon and the sun are all established in you.

verses.text:
मर्त्यता चैव भूतानाममरत्वं दिवौकसाम् ।
त्वयि सर्वं महाबाहो लोककार्यं प्रतिष्ठितम् ॥

meaning.en: The mortality of creatures and the immortality of the heaven-dwellers, mighty-armed one, all worldly activity rests in you.

verses.text:
सा तेऽहं दुःखमाख्यास्ये प्रणयान्मधुसूदन ।
ईशस्त्वं सर्वभूतानां ये दिव्या ये च मानुषाः ॥

meaning.en: Madhusudana, out of love I will tell you my grief; you are the lord of all beings, divine and human.

verses.text:
कथं नु भार्या पार्थानां तव कृष्ण सखी विभो ।
धृष्टद्युम्नस्य भगिनी सभां कृष्येत मादृशी ॥

meaning.en: How, Krishna, could the wife of the Pandavas, your friend, sister of Dhrishtadyumna, one such as I, be dragged into the assembly, Lord?

verses.text:
स्त्रीधर्मिणी वेपमाना रुधिरेण समुक्षिता ।
एकवस्त्रा विकृष्टास्मि दुःखिता कुरुसंसदि ॥

meaning.en: A woman in her season, trembling, drenched in blood, in a single garment, I was dragged in grief into the Kuru assembly.

verses.text:
राजमध्ये सभायां तु रजसाभिसमीरिताम् ।
दृष्ट्वा च मां धार्तराष्ट्राः प्राहसन्पापचेतसः ॥

meaning.en: Seeing me in the middle of the king's assembly, stained with menstrual blood, Dhritarashtra's sons with sinful minds laughed.

verses.text:
दासीभावेन भोक्तुं मामीषुस्ते मधुसूदन ।
जीवत्सु पाण्डुपुत्रेषु पाञ्चालेष्वथ वृष्णिषु ॥

meaning.en: Madhusudana, they wanted to enjoy me as a slave, while the sons of Pandu, the Panchalas and the Vrishnis were alive.

verses.text:
नन्वहं कृष्ण भीष्मस्य धृतराष्ट्रस्य चोभयोः ।
स्नुषा भवामि धर्मेण साहं दासीकृता बलात् ॥

meaning.en: Krishna, by dharma I am the daughter-in-law of both Bhishma and Dhritarashtra, and yet I was made a slave by force.

verses.text:
गर्हये पाण्डवांस्त्वेव युधि श्रेष्ठान्महाबलान् ।
ये क्लिश्यमानां प्रेक्षन्ते धर्मपत्नीं यशस्विनीम् ॥

meaning.en: I blame the Pandavas, great warriors, best in battle, who looked on as their glorious dharma-wife was tormented.

verses.text:
धिग्बलं भीमसेनस्य धिक्पार्थस्य धनुष्मताम् ।
यौ मां विप्रकृतां क्षुद्रैर्मर्षयेतां जनार्दन ॥

meaning.en: Shame on Bhimasena's strength, shame on the Pritha-son's bow, Janardana, that they endured me being wronged by petty men.

verses.text:
शाश्वतोऽयं धर्मपथः सद्भिराचरितः सदा ।
यद्भार्यां परिरक्षन्ति भर्तारोऽल्पबला अपि ॥

meaning.en: This is the eternal path of dharma, always followed by the good, that husbands protect their wives even when they have little strength.

verses.text:
भार्यायां रक्ष्यमाणायां प्रजा भवति रक्षिता ।
प्रजायां रक्ष्यमाणायामात्मा भवति रक्षितः ॥

meaning.en: When a wife is protected, offspring are protected; when offspring are protected, one's own self is protected.

verses.text:
आत्मा हि जायते तस्यां तस्माज्जाया भवत्युत ।
भर्ता च भार्यया रक्ष्यः कथं जायान्ममोदरे ॥

meaning.en: For one's self is born in her, and so a wife is called jaya; and the husband must be protected by his wife. How could they not protect me, who bore their sons?

verses.text:
नन्विमे शरणं प्राप्तान्न त्यजन्ति कदाचन ।
ते मां शरणमापन्नां नान्वपद्यन्त पाण्डवाः ॥

meaning.en: These men never abandon those who come for refuge, yet the Pandavas did not come to my aid when I took refuge in them.

verses.text:
पञ्चेमे पञ्चभिर्जाताः कुमाराश्चामितौजसः ।
एतेषामप्यवेक्षार्थं त्रातव्यास्मि जनार्दन ॥

meaning.en: Five sons of mine, of boundless might, were born to the five; for their sake too, Janardana, I should be protected.

verses.text:
प्रतिविन्ध्यो युधिष्ठिरात्सुतसोमो वृकोदरात् ।
अर्जुनाच्छ्रुतकीर्तिस्तु शतानीकस्तु नाकुलिः ॥

meaning.en: Pratividhya by Yudhishthira, Sutasoma by Vrikodara, Shrutakirti by Arjuna, Shatanika by Nakula,

verses.text:
कनिष्ठाच्छ्रुतकर्मा तु सर्वे सत्यपराक्रमाः ।
प्रद्युम्नो यादृशः कृष्ण तादृशास्ते महारथाः ॥

meaning.en: and Shrutakarma by the youngest; all are of true valor. Krishna, these great chariot-warriors are like Pradyumna.

verses.text:
नन्विमे धनुषि श्रेष्ठा अजेया युधि शात्रवैः ।
किमर्थं धार्तराष्ट्राणां सहन्ते दुर्बलीयसाम् ॥

meaning.en: These are the best with the bow, unconquerable by enemies in battle; why do they endure the weaklings, Dhritarashtra's sons?

verses.text:
अधर्मेण हृतं राज्यं सर्वे दासाः कृतास्तथा ।
सभायां परिकृष्टाहमेकवस्त्रा रजस्वला ॥

meaning.en: The kingdom was taken by unrighteous means, all were made slaves, and I was dragged into the assembly in a single garment, in my season.

verses.text:
नाधिज्यमपि यच्छक्यं कर्तुमन्येन गाण्डिवम् ।
अन्यत्रार्जुनभीमाभ्यां त्वया वा मधुसूदन ॥

meaning.en: No one else could even string the Gandiva, except Arjuna and Bhima, or you, Madhusudana.

verses.text:
धिग्भीमसेनस्य बलं धिक्पार्थस्य च गाण्डिवम् ।
यत्र दुर्योधनः कृष्ण मुहूर्तमपि जीवति ॥

meaning.en: Shame on Bhimasena's strength, shame on Partha's Gandiva, Krishna, that Duryodhana lives even for a moment!

verses.text:
य एतानाक्षिपद्राष्ट्रात्सह मात्राविहिंसकान् ।
अधीयानान्पुरा बालान्व्रतस्थान्मधुसूदन ॥

meaning.en: He who drove these innocents out of the kingdom with their mother, then boys, studying and keeping vows, Madhusudana,

verses.text:
भोजने भीमसेनस्य पापः प्राक्षेपयद्विषम् ।
कालकूटं नवं तीक्ष्णं संभृतं लोमहर्षणम् ॥

meaning.en: that sinner had poison thrown into Bhimasena's food, new, sharp Kalakuta, hair-raising, specially prepared.

verses.text:
तज्जीर्णमविकारेण सहान्नेन जनार्दन ।
सशेषत्वान्महाबाहो भीमस्य पुरुषोत्तम ॥

meaning.en: But it was digested without harm along with the food, Janardana, since Bhima, mighty-armed best of persons, was to survive.

verses.text:
प्रमाणकोट्यां विश्वस्तं तथा सुप्तं वृकोदरम् ।
बद्ध्वैनं कृष्ण गङ्गायां प्रक्षिप्य पुनराव्रजत् ॥

meaning.en: Trusting, Vrikodara slept at Pramanakoti, and he bound him and threw him into the Ganga and went back.

verses.text:
यदा विबुद्धः कौन्तेयस्तदा संछिद्य बन्धनम् ।
उदतिष्ठन्महाबाहुर्भीमसेनो महाबलः ॥

meaning.en: When Kunti's son awoke, mighty-armed Bhimasena of great strength broke his bonds and rose.

verses.text:
आशीविषैः कृष्णसर्पैः सुप्तं चैनमदंशयत् ।
सर्वेष्वेवाङ्गदेशेषु न ममार च शत्रुहा ॥

meaning.en: They had him bitten in his sleep by black serpents of deadly venom, but the slayer of foes did not die, though bitten on every limb.

verses.text:
प्रतिबुद्धस्तु कौन्तेयः सर्वान्सर्पानपोथयत् ।
सारथिं चास्य दयितमपहस्तेन जघ्निवान् ॥

meaning.en: On waking, Kunti's son crushed all the snakes, and with the back of his hand killed his dear charioteer.

verses.text:
पुनः सुप्तानुपाधाक्षीद्बालकान्वारणावते ।
शयानानार्यया सार्धं को नु तत्कर्तुमर्हति ॥

meaning.en: Again at Varanavata they burned the sleeping boys, who lay with their noble mother. Who could do such a thing?

verses.text:
यत्रार्या रुदती भीता पाण्डवानिदमब्रवीत् ।
महद्व्यसनमापन्ना शिखिना परिवारिता ॥

meaning.en: There the noble Kunti, weeping and afraid, said to the Pandavas, surrounded by fire, in great distress:

verses.text:
हा हतास्मि कुतो न्वद्य भवेच्छान्तिरिहानलात् ।
अनाथा विनशिष्यामि बालकैः पुत्रकैः सह ॥

meaning.en: Alas, I am lost! How will there be safety from this fire today? Helpless, I will perish with my little boys.

verses.text:
तत्र भीमो महाबाहुर्वायुवेगपराक्रमः ।
आर्यामाश्वासयामास भ्रातॄंश्चापि वृकोदरः ॥

meaning.en: There mighty-armed Bhima, of the speed and valor of wind, comforted noble Kunti and his brothers, Vrikodara:

verses.text:
वैनतेयो यथा पक्षी गरुडः पततां वरः ।
तथैवाभिपतिष्यामि भयं वो नेह विद्यते ॥

meaning.en: Like Garuda, Vinata's son, best of birds, I will swoop; there is no fear for you here.

verses.text:
आर्यामङ्केन वामेन राजानं दक्षिणेन च ।
अंसयोश्च यमौ कृत्वा पृष्ठे बीभत्सुमेव च ॥

meaning.en: Placing noble Kunti on his left side, the king on his right, the twins on his shoulders and Bibhatsu on his back,

verses.text:
सहसोत्पत्य वेगेन सर्वानादाय वीर्यवान् ।
भ्रातॄनार्यां च बलवान्मोक्षयामास पावकात् ॥

meaning.en: the strong, valiant one suddenly leapt up with speed, took them all, and freed the brothers and noble Kunti from the fire.

verses.text:
ते रात्रौ प्रस्थिताः सर्वे मात्रा सह यशस्विनः ।
अभ्यगच्छन्महारण्यं हिडिम्बवनमन्तिकात् ॥

meaning.en: Setting out at night with their mother, those glorious men reached a great forest, Hidimba's forest, near by.

verses.text:
श्रान्ताः प्रसुप्तास्तत्रेमे मात्रा सह सुदुःखिताः ।
सुप्तांश्चैनानभ्यगच्छद्धिडिम्बा नाम राक्षसी ॥

meaning.en: Tired and deeply sorrowful, they slept there with their mother. A rakshasi named Hidimba came to them as they slept.

verses.text:
भीमस्य पादौ कृत्वा तु स्व उत्सङ्गे ततो बलात् ।
पर्यमर्दत संहृष्टा कल्याणी मृदुपाणिना ॥

meaning.en: She took Bhima's feet onto her lap by force and, delighted, the gracious one pressed them with her soft hands.

verses.text:
तामबुध्यदमेयात्मा बलवान्सत्यविक्रमः ।
पर्यपृच्छच्च तां भीमः किमिहेच्छस्यनिन्दिते ॥

meaning.en: The strong, true-valiant Bhima of immeasurable spirit awoke to her and asked her, "What do you want here, blameless one?"

verses.text:
तयोः श्रुत्वा तु कथितमागच्छद्राक्षसाधमः ।
भीमरूपो महानादान्विसृजन्भीमदर्शनः ॥

meaning.en: Hearing what they said, the vile demon came, with a frightful form and sound, roaring great roars, fearful to see.

verses.text:
केन सार्धं कथयसि आनयैनं ममान्तिकम् ।
हिडिम्बे भक्षयिष्यावो न चिरं कर्तुमर्हसि ॥

meaning.en: With whom are you talking? Bring him to me. Hidimba, we will eat him; you must not delay.

verses.text:
सा कृपासंगृहीतेन हृदयेन मनस्विनी ।
नैनमैच्छत्तदाख्यातुमनुक्रोशादनिन्दिता ॥

meaning.en: Her heart seized with pity, the noble-minded one did not wish to point him out, from compassion.

verses.text:
स नादान्विनदन्घोरान्राक्षसः पुरुषादकः ।
अभ्यद्रवत वेगेन भीमसेनं तदा किल ॥

meaning.en: The man-eating demon, roaring terrible roars, rushed with speed at Bhimasena.

verses.text:
तमभिद्रुत्य संक्रुद्धो वेगेन महता बली ।
अगृह्णात्पाणिना पाणिं भीमसेनस्य राक्षसः ॥

meaning.en: Rushing, the strong demon, enraged, seized Bhimasena's hand with his own, with great speed.

verses.text:
इन्द्राशनिसमस्पर्शं वज्रसंहननं दृढम् ।
संहत्य भीमसेनाय व्याक्षिपत्सहसा करम् ॥

meaning.en: Striking Bhima's firm thunderbolt-like arm, which felt like Indra's lightning, he suddenly flung out his hand against Bhimasena.

verses.text:
गृहीतं पाणिना पाणिं भीमसेनोऽथ रक्षसा ।
नामृष्यत महाबाहुस्तत्राक्रुध्यद्वृकोदरः ॥

meaning.en: Grasped by the demon's hand, mighty-armed Vrikodara could not bear it, and grew angry.

verses.text:
तत्रासीत्तुमुलं युद्धं भीमसेनहिडिम्बयोः ।
सर्वास्त्रविदुषोर्घोरं वृत्रवासवयोरिव ॥

meaning.en: A tumultuous, terrible fight arose between Bhimasena and Hidimba, both skilled in every weapon, like that of Vritra and Vasava.

verses.text:
हत्वा हिडिम्बं भीमोऽथ प्रस्थितो भ्रातृभिः सह ।
हिडिम्बामग्रतः कृत्वा यस्यां जातो घटोत्कचः ॥

meaning.en: After killing Hidimba, Bhima went on with his brothers, putting Hidimba ahead, of whom Ghatotkacha was born.

verses.text:
ततश्च प्राद्रवन्सर्वे सह मात्रा यशस्विनः ।
एकचक्रामभिमुखाः संवृता ब्राह्मणव्रजैः ॥

meaning.en: Then they all set out with their mother, glorious ones, toward Ekachakra, accompanied by bands of Brahmins.

verses.text:
प्रस्थाने व्यास एषां च मन्त्री प्रियहितोऽभवत् ।
ततोऽगच्छन्नेकचक्रां पाण्डवाः संशितव्रताः ॥

meaning.en: When they left, Vyasa became their counselor, dear and well-wishing. Then the Pandavas of strict vows went to Ekachakra.

verses.text:
तत्राप्यासादयामासुर्बकं नाम महाबलम् ।
पुरुषादं प्रतिभयं हिडिम्बेनैव संमितम् ॥

meaning.en: There too they met a mighty man-eater named Baka, as fearsome as Hidimba.

verses.text:
तं चापि विनिहत्योग्रं भीमः प्रहरतां वरः ।
सहितो भ्रातृभिः सर्वैर्द्रुपदस्य पुरं ययौ ॥

meaning.en: Killing that fierce one too, Bhima, best of fighters, went with all his brothers to Drupada's city.

verses.text:
लब्धाहमपि तत्रैव वसता सव्यसाचिना ।
यथा त्वया जिता कृष्ण रुक्मिणी भीष्मकात्मजा ॥

meaning.en: There, Krishna, I too was won while Savyasachi lived there, as you won Rukmini, Bhishmaka's daughter.

verses.text:
एवं सुयुद्धे पार्थेन जिताहं मधुसूदन ।
स्वयंवरे महत्कर्म कृत्वा नसुकरं परैः ॥

meaning.en: So, Madhusudana, I was won by Partha in a fine fight, in the svayamvara, by a deed hard for others to do.

verses.text:
एवं क्लेशैः सुबहुभिः क्लिश्यमानाः सुदुःखिताः ।
निवसामार्यया हीनाः कृष्ण धौम्यपुरःसराः ॥

meaning.en: Thus, tormented by many afflictions and deeply sorrowful, we live without noble Kunti, Krishna, with Dhaumya at our head.

verses.text:
त इमे सिंहविक्रान्ता वीर्येणाभ्यधिकाः परैः ।
विहीनैः परिक्लिश्यन्तीं समुपेक्षन्त मां कथम् ॥

meaning.en: How can these, with the valor of lions and greater strength than their foes, overlook me being tormented by the lowly?

verses.text:
एतादृशानि दुःखानि सहन्ते दुर्बलीयसाम् ।
दीर्घकालं प्रदीप्तानि पापानां क्षुद्रकर्मणाम् ॥

meaning.en: They bear such sorrows from the weak, sinful and petty ones, burning for a long time.

verses.text:
कुले महति जातास्मि दिव्येन विधिना किल ।
पाण्डवानां प्रिया भार्या स्नुषा पाण्डोर्महात्मनः ॥

meaning.en: I was born into a great family, by a divine ordinance, a beloved wife of the Pandavas and daughter-in-law of great Pandu.

verses.text:
कचग्रहमनुप्राप्ता सास्मि कृष्ण वरा सती ।
पञ्चानामिन्द्रकल्पानां प्रेक्षतां मधुसूदन ॥

meaning.en: Yet I, Krishna, a good and virtuous woman, was seized by the hair while five men like Indra looked on, Madhusudana.

verses.text:
इत्युक्त्वा प्रारुदत्कृष्णा मुखं प्रच्छाद्य पाणिना ।
पद्मकोशप्रकाशेन मृदुना मृदुभाषिणी ॥

meaning.en: So saying, Krishna wept, covering her face with her hand, soft as a lotus bud, speaking softly.

verses.text:
स्तनावपतितौ पीनौ सुजातौ शुभलक्षणौ ।
अभ्यवर्षत पाञ्चाली दुःखजैरश्रुबिन्दुभिः ॥

meaning.en: Her full, well-formed, auspicious breasts were drenched by the drops of tears born of sorrow, as Panchali wept.

verses.text:
चक्षुषी परिमार्जन्ती निःश्वसन्ती पुनः पुनः ।
बाष्पपूर्णेन कण्ठेन क्रुद्धा वचनमब्रवीत् ॥

meaning.en: Wiping her eyes and sighing again and again, with a voice full of tears, she spoke in anger.

verses.text:
नैव मे पतयः सन्ति न पुत्रा मधुसूदन ।
न भ्रातरो न च पिता नैव त्वं न च बान्धवाः ॥

meaning.en: I have no husbands, no sons, no brothers, no father, and not even you, Madhusudana, nor kinsmen,

verses.text:
ये मां विप्रकृतां क्षुद्रैरुपेक्षध्वं विशोकवत् ।
न हि मे शाम्यते दुःखं कर्णो यत्प्राहसत्तदा ॥

meaning.en: since you all overlook me, wronged by petty men, as if without grief. My sorrow is not calmed, for Karna laughed at me then.

verses.text:
अथैनामब्रवीत्कृष्णस्तस्मिन्वीरसमागमे ।
रोदिष्यन्ति स्त्रियो ह्येवं येषां क्रुद्धासि भामिनि ॥

meaning.en: Then Krishna said to her in that gathering of heroes, "The wives of those with whom you are angry, fair one, will weep like this.

verses.text:
बीभत्सुशरसंछन्नाञ्शोणितौघपरिप्लुतान् ।
निहताञ्जीवितं त्यक्त्वा शयानान्वसुधातले ॥

meaning.en: Covered by Bibhatsu's arrows, flooded with streams of blood, killed and having given up life, they will lie on the ground.

verses.text:
यत्समर्थं पाण्डवानां तत्करिष्यामि मा शुचः ।
सत्यं ते प्रतिजानामि राज्ञां राज्ञी भविष्यसि ॥

meaning.en: I will do whatever is within my power for the Pandavas; do not grieve. I promise you truly, you will be queen of kings.

verses.text:
पतेद्द्यौर्हिमवाञ्शीर्येत्पृथिवी शकलीभवेत् ।
शुष्येत्तोयनिधिः कृष्णे न मे मोघं वचो भवेत् ॥

meaning.en: Let the sky fall, the Himalaya split, the earth break to pieces, the ocean dry up; Krishna, my word will not be in vain."

verses.text: धृष्टद्युम्न उवाच

meaning.en: Dhrishtadyumna said:

verses.text:
अहं द्रोणं हनिष्यामि शिखण्डी तु पितामहम् ।
दुर्योधनं भीमसेनः कर्णं हन्ता धनंजयः ॥

meaning.en: I will kill Drona, Shikhandi the Grandfather, Bhimasena Duryodhana, and Dhananjaya Karna.

verses.text:
रामकृष्णौ व्यपाश्रित्य अजेयाः स्म शुचिस्मिते ।
अपि वृत्रहणा युद्धे किं पुनर्धृतराष्ट्रजैः ॥

meaning.en: Relying on Rama and Krishna, bright-smiling lady, we are invincible even against the Slayer of Vritra in battle, how much less Dhritarashtra's sons.

verses.text: वैशंपायन उवाच

meaning.en: Vaishampayana said:

verses.text:
इत्युक्तेऽभिमुखा वीरा वासुदेवमुपस्थिता ।
तेषां मध्ये महाबाहुः केशवो वाक्यमब्रवीत् ॥

meaning.en: When this had been said, the heroes, facing Vasudeva, drew near, and in their midst mighty-armed Keshava spoke.
